name: West Virginia Wesleyan College
academic_ranking: Private Methodist-affiliated liberal arts college founded in 1890, accredited by the Higher Learning Commission. ~1,055 students (971 undergraduate). Offers 50+ undergraduate majors and 33 minors plus graduate programs (MBA, MFA, nursing). ~80% of faculty hold terminal degrees; student-faculty ratio ~11.6:1 with average class size of 15.
financial_aid: More than 90% of the student body receives some form of financial aid. Merit scholarships for new students: Presidential $18,000 (3.75 GPA), Dean's $16,000 (3.3 GPA), Merit $14,000 (2.75 GPA). Co-curricular (athletics/arts/service) scholarships can be combined with academic awards. WV residents may add the Promise Scholarship and WV Higher Education Grant. Outside scholarships stack on top of institutional aid. Financial Aid Office: (304) 473-8080. Tuition figure is for 2026-27; total direct cost ~$48,698 including room, board, and fees.
facilities_notes: No softball-specific facility name or venue details were listed on the athletics softball page (checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference. No recent championships or specific program achievements were listed on the softball page (checked 2026-07).
notes: Data sourced live 2026-07 from wesleyanbobcats.com softball coaches and roster pages and wvwc.edu financial aid / total direct cost pages.
